INSERT INTO LOT_DETL (CO_CODE,LC_CODE,CO_YEAR,CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,SR_NO,VCH_DATE,VCH_TYPE,INOUT_TYPE,ENTRY_TYPE,BOOK_NAME,AC_CODE,IT_CODE,IT_TYPE,LOT_NO, IT_PCS,IT_GWT,IT_NWT,IT_SIGN,HD_VCH_NO,MAIN_USER,DATA_TYPE,DATA_TRFR,TAG_NO,VCH_SRNO,TAG_IT_CODE,EMP_CODE,PR_CODE,KR_CODE) Select A.CO_CODE,A.LC_CODE,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.SR_NO,A.VCH_DATE,B.BOOK_SNAME,B.BOOK_INOUT,'L',B.MAIN_BOOK,A.AC_CODE,A.IT_CODE,A.IT_TYPE,A.LOT_NO, A.ITM_PCS,A.ITM_GWT,A.ITM_NWT,'+',A.VCH_NO,A.MAIN_USER,B.DATA_TYPE,'N','',0,'',C.EMP_CODE,A.PR_CODE,D.AC_SHORT FROM ((PR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN PR_DATA AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = C.LC_CODE AND A.CO_YEAR = C.CO_YEAR AND A.CO_BOOK = C.CO_BOOK AND A.VCH_NO = C.VCH_NO) LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_CODE = D.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND B.MAIN_BOOK IN ('PURCHASE','B2B PURC') AND B.BOOK_INOUT = 'I' ? AND A.CO_BOOK =' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_NO =' ? ' ? AND A.LOT_NO <> ''

SELECT B.IT_TYPE,A.IT_CODE FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO <> 'N' ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY B.IT_TYPE,A.IT_CODE ORDER BY B.IT_TYPE,A.IT_CODE
SELECT * FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? IT_CODE ? '

SELECT C.CO_CODE As CoCode,C.VCH_TYPE As VchTyp,C.VCH_NO VchNo,C.STK_DATE As StkDate,C.TAG_NO,A.IT_CODE As ItCode,C.TBL_CODE As Counter,C.DESIGN_NO As Design,C.ITM_SIZE As Size,1 As Qty,C.ITM_PCS as Pcs,C.ITM_GWT As Grwt,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWt,C.LBR_RATE As LbrRate,C.LBR_PRC As Lbrprc,C.LBR_AMT AS LbrAmt,C.OTH_AMT As OthAmt, C.KR_COST As PrCost,C.ITM_MRP As Mrp,C.KR_NAME As KrName,C.CO_BOOK As Book,C.BOOK_NAME As BookName,C.AC_CODE As AcCode,C.VCH_SRNO from (MAIN_STOCK AS A INNER JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = C.LC_CODE And A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO And A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO And A.IT_CODE = C.IT_CODE)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> 'N' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.IT_CODE = ' ? IT_CODE ? ' ? GROUP BY C.CO_CODE,C.VCH_TYPE,C.VCH_NO,C.STK_DATE,C.TAG_NO,A.IT_CODE,C.TBL_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_SIZE,C.ITM_PCS,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.LBR_RATE,C.LBR_PRC,C.LBR_AMT,C.OTH_AMT, ? C.KR_COST,C.ITM_MRP,C.KR_NAME,C.CO_BOOK,C.BOOK_NAME,C.AC_CODE,C.VCH_SRNO ? HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN='+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY C.TAG_NO
